name: agent-loop
description: Autonomous coding loop for long-running tasks (refactors, new features, test sweeps). A bash harness re-invokes a fresh headless tick per task for OS-level context reset, handles blockers with a taxonomy, and builds dynamic sprint contracts per task. Requires the superpowers plugin; bundles the postmortem plugin and recommends the permissions plugin for its /permissions-advisor pre-flight check.
